question: Which of the following expressions is the simplified form of (2x + 5)(2x - 5) - (2x - 3)² ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use the identity: (a + b)(a − b) = a² − b².

Simplify (2x + 5)(2x − 5) ⇒ 4x² − 25.

Simplify −(2x − 3)² ⇒ −(4x² − 12x + 9).

Combine terms: 4x² − 25 − 4x² + 12x − 9 ⇒ 12x − 34.

Factorize: 2(6x − 17).

**∴ Answer = 2(6x − 17)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Expression: (2x + 5)(2x − 5) − (2x − 3)²

**Formula used:**

(a + b)(a − b) = a² − b²

**Calculations:**

(2x + 5)(2x − 5) = 4x² − 25.

⇒ −(2x − 3)² = −(4x² − 12x + 9).

⇒ Combine: 4x² − 25 − 4x² + 12x − 9 = 12x − 34.

⇒ Factorize: 2(6x − 17).

**∴ The correct answer is 2(6x − 17).**
